cues.label: CA Rajesh
cues.text: Welcome back students! Amalgamation nadakumbo Section 32(1) Fifth Proviso engineyanu apply cheyyunnathennu namukku padikama. Business reorganization nadannalum total allowable Depreciation-il mathram aarum excess claim cheyyan padilla!

cues.label: Fifth Proviso Cap on Depreciation
cues.text: Amalgamation nadannittillekill etra Depreciation kittumo, athu mathramayirikkum aggregate Depreciation limit. Corporate restructuring vachitt extra benefit onnum kittilla.

cues.label: Apportionment in Ratio of Days
cues.text: Total calculated Depreciation rendered assets use cheytha exact number of days basis-il split cheyyanam. Amalgamating Company-kum Amalgamated Company-kum idayil idhu apportion cheyyanam.

cues.label: Irrelevance of Actual Transfer Price
cues.text: Assets transfer cheytha ₹60 Lakhs valiya consideration value onnum calculation-il edukilla! WDV as per Section 43(6) base cheythu mathramayirikkum calculation.

cues.label: 50% Rate for Assets Used Less than 180 Days
cues.text: Second Proviso prakaram Previous Year-il 180 days-il thazhe put to use cheytha assets-inu half depreciation rate i.e. 7.5% mathrame allow cheyyu.

cues.label: Tax Officer
cues.text: Exam question-il Sai Ltd. 01.01.2026-il Shirdi Ltd. umayi amalgamate aayi. Timeline clear-ayi note cheythu step-by-step computation nokkam!

cues.label: Step 1: Compute Standalone Total Depreciation
cues.text: First, normal full year Depreciation kandupidikkuka. Old WDV ₹40 Lakhs @ 15% = ₹6.00 Lakhs. New Addition ₹14.40 Lakhs @ 7.5% = ₹1.08 Lakhs. Total = ₹7.08 Lakhs.

cues.label: Step 2: Existing Assets Days Breakdown
cues.text: Existing asset 01.04.2025 thott 31.12.2025 vare Sai Ltd. 275 days use cheythu. Balance 90 days Shirdi Ltd. use cheythu (275:90 ratio out of 365 days).

cues.label: Step 3: New Addition Assets Days Breakdown
cues.text: 01.11.2025-nu vanga asset 31.12.2025 vare Sai Ltd. 61 days use cheythu. Balance 01.01.2026 to 31.03.2026 (90 days) Shirdi Ltd. use cheythu (Total 151 days used).

cues.label: Step 4: Final Tax Deduction Allocation
cues.text: Sai Ltd. gets ₹4,52,055 + ₹43,629 = ₹4,95,684. Shirdi Ltd. gets remaining ₹1,47,945 + ₹64,371 = ₹2,12,316. Total equals ₹7.08 Lakhs perfectly!

cues.label: Clause A: Cap Limit Principle
cues.text: Aggregate Depreciation allowed to Amalgamating Company and Amalgamated Company shall not exceed the amount calculated at prescribed rates as if the Amalgamation had not taken place.

cues.label: Clause B: Day-wise Usage Apportionment
cues.text: Depreciation shall be apportioned between Amalgamating and Amalgamated companies in the ratio of the number of days for which the assets were used by them in the Previous Year.

cues.label: Clause C: 180 Days Restricted Benefit Rule
cues.text: If any asset acquired during the Previous Year is put to use for less than 180 days, Depreciation rate is restricted to 50% of the normal rate for the entire block calculation.

cues.label: Clause D: Non-Cognizance of Revaluation Value
cues.text: The actual consideration or agreed price for transfer of assets during Amalgamation shall be completely ignored while determining Written Down Value under Section 43(6).
